light:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one image design board for one Chinese Interview Forge page in ONE specified theme. Use the supplied accepted workspace image solely as a STYLE REFERENCE, not as content to copy. Create a finished professional application UI, crisp readable Simplified Chinese, restrained developer-tool aesthetics and indigo/lavender gradients.
Composition: one wide high-resolution landscape DESIGN BOARD with a large realistic desktop viewport on the LEFT (roughly 75% width), and a narrow H5 viewport on the RIGHT (roughly 25% width, 390px-layout proportions). Both show THE SAME PAGE and same information architecture adapted to their widths. No device hardware, perspective, marketing poster or giant captions. Small labels "桌面" and "H5" above the viewports. H5 uses concise top navigation, single-column cards, and bottom navigation or a contextual action bar; do NOT shrink a desktop sidebar or three columns into mobile. Do not repeat two desktop pages. Desktop top app bar 72px, navigation sidebar about192px, main padding22px, panels radius14px, buttons8px, comfortable text and fine-line icons. Desktop has left navigation with core entries 工作台 / 题库 / 我的练习 / 面试房间 / 实验室 and a quieter 更多 menu; show active location, context breadcrumb, compact avatar. On public login and portfolio pages use appropriate public header instead of private navigation.
LIGHT palette: page#f6f7fb panels#ffffff secondary#eef1f7 text#1f293b muted#657087 border#e1e6ef accent#5263dc with white text. Button gradient indigo to lavender. Soft very pale blue/lilac radial gradient washes at title perimeter and selected items. Reading and input panels solid.
DARK palette: page#10131d panels#191e2b secondary#222939 text#e8edf8 muted#a0acc3 border#30394b accent#9eaafa with deep indigo text#151a32. Button gradient#9eaafa→#baabf8. Restrained deep indigo/plum glow near header; no neon or pure black. Reading and input panels solid dark.
Use only the requested theme, matching the reference theme. Same layout, cards and content between the light/dark companion boards. Gradients on header surroundings, primary buttons and selected items, never strong underneath reading/editing.
All data shown is fictional design data. Put small legible "设计稿 · 示例数据" at the bottom of BOTH viewports. No fake actual production verification. Product is interview learning, not a generic analytics dashboard. Do not add billing, audio/video calls, Google/social login, authentication choices, secret data, live AI capabilities or features not listed in the page brief. Clear accessible actions and status text. No watermark, ornamental 3D mascots, stock photos, garbled text, excessive charts or huge hero slogans.
